title: Content Bundle v1
description: A versioned content bundle emitted by lamella or a compatible packaging tool. Discriminated by bundle_type across three target platforms: Codex, Copilot, and Kiro. Each variant is self-contained; consumers match on bundle_type before reading platform-specific fields.

CodexBundle.title: Codex Bundle
CodexBundle.description: A content bundle targeting the Codex platform.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Always '1.0' for this schema.

bundle_type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a Codex bundle.

bundle_id.description: Unique identifier for this bundle. Assigned by the producer.

format_version.description: Semantic version of the bundle format (e.g. '1.2.0').

manifest.description: Bundle manifest describing the package contents.

description.description: Short description of what the bundle provides.

content_root.description: Relative path to the root directory of packaged content.

tags.description: Optional tags for categorization or filtering.

min_tool_version.description: Minimum tool version required to consume this bundle (semver).

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this bundle was published.
